title: Easy Walk, Stunning Views
text: An easy, peaceful hike near the Alhambra, suitable for anyone. The views of Granada and of the Alhambra from the Silla del Moro are beautiful. Our guide was wonderful, and it was nice to share the walk with the group. Highly recommend
author: miguelangelcI4608BU

title: Surprised  and wonderful experience 😊
text:
It was great to have a overall birds eye view of  Granada .
The trail walk was not too physical  demanding  the length  of the walk is well thought  after ... my friend he was a senior  we both enjoyed  very much .
We had lovely  time , relaxed in the nature, best of all we escaped the crowds  in Granada  city .
author: dorasm2025

title: A great walk following the water to Alhambra.
text: It was a great experience to walk with Violeta. She knew so much about the history of Granada and the people with all the different religions who lived her. We enjoyed the views.
author: F5532DOingridb

title: Exhausting walk
text: A particularly nerve-wracking walk. The guide knew how to insert rest stops at the right moments with her fantastic stories.
author: E1861NUritas

title: An enjoyable cycle through picturesque hills.
text:
Julio was a great guide. The tour was really enjoyable and not too strenuous. We passed through some lovely scenery.
I would highly recommend this tour as a relaxing cycle through picturesque countryside.
author: janettet984

title: Excellent hike
text: Exceptionally beautiful walk through the hills surrounding Granada. Our guide Ruth was patient, knowledgeable and considerate. Well worth the effort, there are some steep parts and some narrow passes so be aware and prepare accordingly
author: Pioneer11456989220

title: The Best Secret Views of Granda!!!
text: It was a beautiful walk with extraordinary views and the best Guide in the area, Kaell. I learned a lot during the tour and had a lot of fun!
author: isa_arathoon

title: Great guide, fabulous scenery
text: George the guide was very knowledgeable and fun. He knew lots of history about the area and was able to present them in a way that made it enjoyable for kids and adults . Beautiful scenery and a trail that took you off the beaten path
author: Ruth W

title: Refresh yourself with nature and unique city perspectives!
text: This was the best tour I took in 2 weeks in Spain! Andalucia has many cultural treasures but also amazing natural beauty.  Don’t visit without experiencing that beauty.  In one morning this tour let me get away from the crowds in Granada,  experience refreshing nature and get a unique perspective on the Alhambra.  The trails were cool and green and the views were spectacular!  The role of water in the development of the Alhambra was fascinating!  (A great supplement or alternative to an Alhambra visit)  Jorge was a delightful guide and easily adjusted his pace when needed.  For reference I am
author: sb2009

title: We didn’t take get the...
text: We didn’t get the hiking tour of the Hidden Water Trails of the Alhambra, as it was replaced with a Segway tour at the same price. The guide was excellent and helped make the experience enjoyable. However, it was a slight disappointment to miss the water trails, and the Segway route felt quite similar to an activity we had done the previous day.
author: Uzma_W
